Software Engineer Intern, Backend (Summer 2027)

About the team
Our Payments Infrastructure team builds the APIs that move money for millions of businesses. As an intern you will own a project end to end.

What you'll do
• Design, build and ship backend services in Go or Java that handle real production traffic
• Write clear REST APIs and work with PostgreSQL and Kafka
• Improve reliability of distributed systems through testing, monitoring and on-call shadowing
• Collaborate with engineers and product managers on technical design docs

Minimum qualifications
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028
• Experience with at least one of Go, Java, Python or C++
• Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms
• Experience building projects outside of class (internships, open source, side projects)

Preferred qualifications
• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or AWS
• Familiarity with distributed systems concepts such as consensus and replication
• Prior internship experience

Benefits
Competitive pay ($50/hr), housing stipend.
We are an equal opportunity employer. We are unable to sponsor visas for this role.
